title: cerastium nigrescens
intro: Cerastium nigrescens, commonly known as the Black Mouse-ear Chickweed, is a species of flowering plant in the carnation family that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Cerastium nigrescens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative properties, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium nigrescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
